subject: Onramp options and annual usage guarantee — proposed Starter/Growth/Enterprise tiers
messages:
From: Sara Malik <sara@omnimed.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajat Sen <rajat.s@omnimed.ai>, Procurement <procurement@omnimed.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing — annual commit question

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the latency numbers look promising. Before we push this through procurement, procurement asked for an example of annual commit structures and how onramp/ramp months work. High level questions from our finance team: 

- If we commit to an annual token volume, how do you treat the first 2–3 months where usage is low? Any onramp credits or smoothing?
- What are the effective per-token discounts at Starter (50k/mo), Growth (250k/mo), and Enterprise (1M+/mo) commitment levels?
- Can you show an example with an initial 3‑month ramp and a guaranteed minimum?

Can you send a short playbook or example schedule we can share with procurement? PDF or spreadsheet is fine.

Appreciate it — we’re trying to lock the SOW this quarter.

Best,
Sara Malik
Head of Product, OmniMed

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Malik <sara@omnimed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp options and annual usage guarantee — proposed Starter/Growth/Enterprise tiers

Sara — thanks for the note and great questions. Attaching a concise playbook (PDF) and a sample CSV showing a 3-month ramp, billing smoothing, and the effective per-token rates at each tier. Quick summary inline below to get procurement started: 

Short summary (high level):
- Starter: 600k tokens/year (50k/mo equivalent). List price: $0.0045/token. Committed rate: $0.0038/token (15% discount) with 3-month onramp credits equal to 25% of monthly committed tokens for months 1–3.
- Growth: 3M tokens/year (250k/mo equiv). Committed rate: $0.0028/token (38% discount). Onramp: step ramp (month1=30%, month2=60%, month3=100%) with partial credits for shortfall vs committed ramp.
- Enterprise: 12M+ tokens/year. Committed rate: custom — typical range $0.0018–$0.0022/token (51–61% off list) depending on billing terms and SLAs. Onramp: bespoke credits + a 90–120 day runway clause.

Key policy notes:
- Credits for ramp shortfall are applied as dollar credits against future invoices rather than token rollovers.
- We include a 30-day grace for initial production stabilization (no overage charges for the first 30 days after go-live if within ramp schedule).
- We can include a capped burst allowance for the first two quarters to handle pilot spikes.

Next steps: If procurement wants numbers in a signed SOW/DocuSign, we can prepare a templated addendum with the selected tier and the ramp schedule. I’ve CC’d Ben and Marissa to confirm margin for Growth tier concessions.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short call invite if that helps.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts (Redwood Inference)
Attachment: omni_commit_terms_v1.pdf
From: Procurement <procurement@omnimed.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp options and annual usage guarantee — proposed Starter/Growth/Enterprise tiers

Kimberly — procurement here. Two follow-ups: 

1) We need an example amortization to understand cashflow impact: if we sign a 3M token annual commit (Growth) at $0.0028/token with a 90‑day ramp where usage hits 60% in month2 and 100% month3, what does our monthly invoice look like vs list? Can you provide a line-by-line example?

2) For Enterprise: what SLA / uptime credits are tied to the deeper discounts? Can you outline the standard SLA and the credit ladder?

If you can send a one-page table for both, we can move to legal.

Thanks,
OmniMed Procurement

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onramp options and annual usage guarantee — pricing carveouts

Kim / Marissa — quick internal note on acceptable concessions for OM-3421: 

- Growth tier concession: we can keep $0.0028/token IF they commit to annual prepay of at least 50% or 12-month ACH schedule. Otherwise push to $0.0030/token. Offer a 30% onramp credit (applied as invoice credit) for months 1–3; cap total credit at $12k.
- Enterprise: we should tie the deepest discount band to a 12‑month prepay + 99.9% SLA with an expanded incident response window. If they need SOC2 or additional audit support, add a one-time compliance fee.
- Billing examples: I’ll attach a quick invoice mock in the follow-up. Keep the 30-day grace.

If Kimberly wants to make our offer more competitive, we can include a one-time migration credit (up to $8k) to help offset integration costs.

Ben
Senior Director, Revenue Operations

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@omnimed.ai>, Sara Malik <sara@omnimed.ai>, Rajat Sen <rajat.s@omnimed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Onramp & annual commit — Growth tier proposal (OM-3421)

Team — following internal alignment, here’s the concrete proposal we’re ready to sign into a short DocuSign addendum: 

Proposal highlights (Growth tier, OM-3421):
- Annual commit: 3,000,000 tokens/year (250k token/mo equivalent)
- Effective committed rate: $0.0029/token (includes a limited 0.1c concession from ops without prepay)
- Ramp schedule: Month1=30% of monthly committed tokens, Month2=60%, Month3=100% (shortfall converted to invoice credit applied over next 2 invoices)
- Onramp credit cap: $10,000 (applied as invoice credit; not token rollover)
- Grace window: 30 days post-go-live with no overage charges if within ramp schedule; capped burst allowance of +25% of committed monthly tokens for first 90 days.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime target. Credits per SLA underperformance defined in addendum.
- Add-ons: migration credit ($6k) if they sign within 14 days and provide 50% prepay.

Attached is a DocuSign link to the templated addendum; it includes the billing example table Ben is preparing. If this looks good I’ll route for signatures and loop Legal.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/OM-3421
Attachment: usage_onramp_examples.csv

Thanks all — happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk through the invoice example.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts
